Application Data.NAME: Sunset Recreation Club
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Sunset Recreation Club is a community-oriented facility offering a variety of recreational activities, including fitness classes, sports leagues, and social events. We provide a safe and welcoming environment for members of all ages to engage in physical activity, socialize, and participate in organized programs. Our amenities include a gym, swimming pool, tennis courts, and multi-purpose rooms for classes and gatherings. We prioritize health, wellness, and community engagement through various membership options and seasonal events.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/15/2022, a member slipped and fell on a wet floor in the gym area due to inadequate signage, resulting in a sprained ankle. The claim was submitted for $2,500. The claim is currently closed as it was settled out of court. On 03/22/2023, equipment rental from a local sports league resulted in damages to a rented tennis net worth $1,000. The claim is still in progress as the investigation is ongoing.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, Heavy Duty Security Safe, Model HS-5000
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing surrounding the facility, on-site security personnel during operating hours, and regular patrols of the premises during off-hours.
